gear_giant.summon.title: Gear Giant
gear_giant.summon.subtitle: Stress resonance awakens the steel colossus
gear_giant.summon.chat: §cThe Gear Giant has awakened! Every power network nearby is trembling...
gear_giant.healing: §dGear servants are channeling stress into the Giant - kill them first!
gear_giant.invuln.end: §eThe stress shell subsided - attacks land again!
gear_giant.core.shattered: §eThe Gear Giant Core has served its purpose, shattering in a burst of sparks.
gear_giant.hook.caught: §cThe mechanical hook claw has you - you are dragged toward the Giant!
advancement.gear_giant.placed_core.name: A Mechanical Pact
advancement.gear_giant.placed_core.desc: Place a Gear Giant Core and feed it rotational stress
advancement.gear_giant.slay.name: Gear Giant
advancement.gear_giant.slay.desc: Defeat the three-phase Gear Giant and stop its gears
advancement.gear_giant.trophy.name: Where Loot Belongs
advancement.gear_giant.trophy.desc: Craft a Gear Giant Trophy from the Giant Power Core
gear_giant.brass_gear_chest.tooltip: Holds %1$s x %2$s = %3$s stacks; contents travel with the box
gear_giant.core.desc.1: Place the core on the ground and spin an adjacent Create shaft (>=16 RPM)
gear_giant.core.desc.2: After ~10s of charging, the Gear Giant awakens above the core
gear_giant.core.desc.3: The core shatters and is lost once the summon completes - craft spares
gear_giant.core.desc.4: Stays dormant while a Gear Giant is already alive within 96 blocks
gear_giant.hook_tool.desc.1: Hold right-click to aim: a mob within 64 blocks in view gets locked on
gear_giant.hook_tool.desc.2: The reticle closes and turns red when locked; release to reel it to you
gear_giant.hook_tool.desc.3: Release with nothing locked to fire a wild shot that simply retracts
